about: Units of the correspondence audit of Luthier, read by scripts/audit_correspondence.py. Each unit is one model call that maps one direction over its files, then one skeptic call that tries to refute what the first found. direction: spec (specification to implementation), impl (implementation to specification), docs (documentation to specification and implementation). files is text for the prompt. verify says which entries of a map go to its skeptic: every entry whose status is not in exclude_statuses, plus the first spot_checks entries whose status is spot_check_status. audited_paths are the paths the script warns about when they have uncommitted changes, since the audit reads the commit.

units.label: spec-02-03
units.files: docs/semantica/02-grammar.md and docs/semantica/03-libraries.md (check the grammar against src/luthier/lexer.py, parser.py, syntax.py, and the libraries against src/luthier/lib/)

units.label: spec-05
units.files: docs/semantica/05-static-semantics.md, every section (rules R1 to R11, reports, certification, presentations, open)

units.label: impl-front
units.files: src/luthier/lexer.py, parser.py, syntax.py, pretty.py, api.py, and src/luthier/core.lut

units.label: impl-tools
units.files: src/luthier/cli.py, certify.py, testing.py, generators.py, graph.py, arrays.py, tables.py, rational.py, text.py

units.label: docs
units.files: README.md and examples/ (and docs/semantica/README if any)
